name: Billy Doe Meats
verdict: For Billy Doe Meats, the biggest movement is a 39.85% drop in Google Business Profile actions over the last 7 days (against 457 total GBP actions in the past 28 days, including 48 calls, 86 directions, and 323 web clicks), likely driven by reduced local search visibility or seasonal dip in foot traffic intent. On a positive note, GA4 sessions are up 23.18% week over week, suggesting the website itself is attracting more visitors despite the GBP decline.

performance.verdict: Ads dark since renewal; GBP eroding while GA4 holds — spend restart is overdue.

findings.text: Meta and Google spend is $0 across all 28 days of the renewal window — no paid activity has run since Aug 1.
Live-Cooking Shoot 1 (due Aug 14) has no completed event — 14 days overdue, blocking fresh creative for restart.
GBP actions dropped -39.85% week-over-week; last 3 days show 9, 0, 0 — near-complete local intent collapse with zero paid support.
GA4 sessions up 23.18% WoW and 3-day avg (271–294–238) is stable near the 28-day mean of ~265 — organic site pull is intact despite paid silence.
Purchases and revenue read $0 across all 28 days; Shopify pixel inconsistency documented, but zero paid spend confirms zero attributable ecom activity.

suggestions.text: Restart Meta campaigns at ~$33/day ($1,000/mo floor) using approved stock-footage creatives immediately.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend has been $0 since the Aug 1 renewal start — no paid activity has run for 28 days. Restart using approved stock-footage and facility-footage creatives at the SOW floor of ~$33/day ($1,000/mo). GA4 sessions are holding at ~265/day organically, giving a live audience to convert. Success check: confirmed spend delivery and first purchase attribution within 3 days of launch (by 2026-08-31).

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions daily; if 3-day avg stays at 0–9 after Meta restarts, escalate to local SEO review.
